changes_no_result: No arm, loss, threshold or contrast is affected. This script produces no performance number. It exists to decide whether the run's coefficient-sign agreement can be read as a biological statement.
how_to_read: A high condition number with an effective rank far below the column count means the individual coefficients are not identified: ridge distributes weight among near-duplicate columns and the sign of any one of them is arbitrary. In that case the run's coefficient-sign agreement is a statement about the design, not about the resource's biology, and must not be reported as evidence that the signs are wrong.
label: POST_HOC_DIAGNOSTIC
report: post-hoc: identifiability of ridge coefficients on F-series activity columns
